text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki dashes across the finish line 
of the Arima Kinen. A massive ovation 
echoes from the stands...!

Though overcome with emotion, Fuji Kiseki 
stayed strong to give the audience a 
dream. Bowing gracefully, she promised 
that the "miracle" would continue—

"To become the greatest entertainer." Fuji 
Kiseki fulfilled that goal.

And so, Fuji Kiseki's show came to an end. 
Yet every ending is also a beginning. The 
curtain on her next show will rise in no 
time—
